title: Trade buyer commitment valuation
description: ADR-SHARED-042 section 14, Decision 7 (Platform Owner, 2026-10-22): the amount Decision 5 spend control reserves and commits for a B2B purchase is the complete, finalised buyer purchase obligation in the transaction currency's minor units. It includes every buyer-payable product, service, freight, handling, insurance, tax, duty and other contractual charge, less genuine commercial price reductions. Payment timing and tender never reduce it: gift cards, wallet or store balance, tender credits, deposits already collected and credit terms are not components. Trade computes the valuation server-side from the finalised, authoritative native pricing, tax, discount and fulfilment facts with integer arithmetic; a mutable cart total is never trusted on its own. Its buyer_commitment_amount_minor populates amount_minor of the TradeBuyerExecutionContext, the BuyerAuthorityReceipt and the spend reservation, and its valuation_digest is bound into each. Any material change (quantity, negotiated price, discount, tax, shipping, currency, Site or Incoterm) is a new valuation, digest and authorization evaluation. An undetermined component never authorises a commitment: it needs an authoritative final quotation or a separately governed maximum-price commitment. There is no currency substitution; cross-currency aggregation needs its own governed FX contract. This contract activates nothing.

valuationDigest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical form of the valuation's binding fields: a JSON object with exactly basis, buyer_commitment_amount_minor, components (each with exactly component_kind, amount_minor, determination and source_reference, sorted by component_kind then source_reference), currency, maximum_commitment_reference (null unless GOVERNED_MAXIMUM), resource_id, resource_version and transaction_digest; keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace, integers in plain decimal, UTF-8. scripts/tests/test_buyer_commitment_valuation.py is the reference implementation.

componentKind.description: What the buyer becomes obligated to pay, or a genuine commercial reduction of it. Tender (gift card, wallet, store credit, deposit already collected, payment on account) is deliberately absent: a payment instrument never reduces the purchase obligation. A seller's own expenses that are not chargeable to the buyer are never components.

determination.description: FINAL: from the finalised native record or an authoritative final quotation. GOVERNED_MAXIMUM: the not-to-exceed amount of a separately governed maximum-price commitment. An estimate is neither and never authorises a commitment.

amount_minor.description: Signed minor units in the valuation currency: discounts are zero or negative, every charge zero or positive. A discount is deducted once, at the level it was granted.

source_reference.description: The authoritative native fact the component was read from (for example a line item, adjustment, shipping method or tax line identifier), so the valuation can be independently reconciled.

BuyerCommitmentValuation.description: One valuation of one immutable purchase version. Semantic rules consumers must also apply: buyer_commitment_amount_minor equals the sum of every component's amount_minor; at least one MERCHANDISE component exists; a FINAL basis has only FINAL components; valuation_digest equals the canonical digest of the binding fields.

basis.description: FINAL_PRICED: every component is final. GOVERNED_MAXIMUM: some component is bounded by a governed maximum-price commitment named in maximum_commitment_reference.

maximum_commitment_reference.description: The separately governed maximum-price commitment. Required for GOVERNED_MAXIMUM, forbidden otherwise.

buyer_commitment_amount_minor.description: The complete buyer purchase obligation. It populates amount_minor of the execution context, buyer receipt and spend reservation.

incoterm.description: The agreed Incoterm when it decides who bears freight, insurance or duties; a change is a new valuation.
